sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The <radical>five</radical> radical and the <kanji>five</kanji> kanji are the same.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: <kanji>Five</kanji> is the number of buildings <reading>Go</reading>dzilla (<ja>ご</ja>) will knock down. Oh, look! There he goes now.
sourceData.readingInfo: One, two, three, four, five—GODZILLA IS HERE GO GO, RUN!
